output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the sender has enough balance to transfer. This could lead to the sender having more tokens than they actually have. The transfer function should also check if the recipient is a contract. If it is, the transfer function should call a callback function in the recipient contract. This will allow the recipient to execute arbitrary code in response to a token transfer. The recipient contract could be hacked by the sender.
